English.question: ১) An extra message  added at the end of a letter after it is signed is called___.
English.exp:
Postscript (n) (সংক্ষেপে PS): চিঠিতে স্বাক্ষরের পরে যুক্ত বাক্যাবলী; পুনশ্চ; অতিরিক্ত বা সর্বশেষ তথ্য।
Source: Bangla Academy Dictionary- English to Bangla

English.question: ২) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) After she bought herself a new automobile, she sold her bicycle.
English.option2: খ) After she had bought himself a new automobile, she sold her bicycle.
English.option3: গ) After she had bought herself a new automobile, she sold her bicycle.
English.option4: ঘ) After she bought himself a new automobile, she had sold her bicycle.
English.exp:
The subject is she; the reflexive pronoun (herself) must agree with the subject. Apart from, this sentence follows the past perfect tense formula.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL

English.question: ৩) Linkers are used in____.
English.exp: Linkers are used in paragraph.

English.question: ৪) Choose the wrong sentence.
English.option1: ক) Do you know where he went?
English.option2: খ) Who will paint that picture?
English.option3: গ) Can you tell me what time it is?
English.exp:
Can you tell me what time it is? or Could you tell me what time it is? Both sentences are right.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL

English.question: ৫) How many parts are there in a letter?
English.exp: There are six parts in a letter.

English.question: ৬) Choose the wrong sentence.
English.option1: ক) The land is belonged to an old lady.
English.option2: খ) They parted from one another suddenly.
English.option3: গ) The leader expressed himself forcibly.
English.option4: ঘ) Mother bought me an ice cream.
English.exp: Belong passive voice এ ব্যবহৃত হয় না।

English.question: ৭) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) I could prove that she does it.
English.option2: খ) He assume that we agree with him.
English.option3: গ) I forget who tell me this.
English.option4: ঘ) I wonder when he will pay me back.
English.exp:
Right sentences are: I can prove that she did it.
He assumes that we agree with him.
I forgot who had told me this.
Source: A Practical English Grammar- Oxford University Press.

English.question: ৮) Choose the wrong sentence.
English.option1: ক) The flock of birds are circling overhead.
English.option2: খ) The herd of cattle cattle is breaking away.
English.option3: গ) Ten miles is too much to run in one day.
English.exp:
Right sentence: The flock of birds is circling overhead.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL

English.question: ৯) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) Joan hates to ride her bicycle to school.
English.option2: খ) Joan hates riding her bicycle to school.
English.option3: গ) Joan hates ride her bicycle to school.
English.exp:
Some verbs can be followed by either the infinitive or the gerund with no change of meaning. ‘Hate’ is a such kind of verb. So, both sentences (a & b) are right.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 85

English.question: ১০) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) There are no reason for leaving this early.
English.option2: খ) There is no reason of leaving this early.
English.option3: গ) There are no reason on leave this early.
English.option4: ঘ) There is no reason for leaving this early.
English.exp: Some nouns + preposition are followed by the gerund.  Reason is a such kind of noun. So the correct sentence will be: There is no reason for leaving this early. Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 87

English.question: ১১) Choose the wrong sentence.
English.option1: ক) They are understanding the problem now.
English.option2: খ) We want to leave now.
English.option3: গ) The coffee tastes delicious now.
English.option4: ঘ) The secretary is typing the letter now.
English.exp:
Understand is stative verb. It has no continuous tense. So the correct sentence will be, “They understand the problem now.”
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 57 & 58

English.question: ১২) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) After George returned to his house, he was reading a book
English.option2: খ) After George had returned to his house, he read a book
English.option3: গ) After George had returned to his house, he was reading a book
English.option4: ঘ) After George returned to his house, he read a book
English.exp:
This sentence follows the past perfect tense formula: After + sub + had + past participle form of a verb object, Sub+ imple past form of a verb + object.
read (third-person singular simple present reads, present participle reading, simple past read, past participle read)
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 107 & 242

English.question: ১৩) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) No one would had attended the lecture, if you told the truth about the guest speaker.
English.option2: খ) No one would have attended the lecture, if you told the truth about the guest speaker.
English.option3: গ) No one have attended the lecture, if you told the truth about the guest speaker.
English.option4: ঘ) No one would have attended the lecture, if you had told the truth about the guest speaker.
English.exp:
Third conditional:- would/could/might have + Vpp + extension, had + past perfect + extension
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 160 & 247

English.question: ১৪) Choose the wrong sentence.
English.option1: ক) None of the students have finished the exam yet.
English.option2: খ) No example are relevant to this case.
English.option3: গ) No examples are relevant to this case.
English.exp:
Correct sentence of option “খ”: No examples are relevant to this case.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 72

English.question: ১৫) Cohesion & coherence is essential in _____.
English.exp:
Cohesion (Unity) & Coherence (Logical Sequence of thoughts) is essential in paragraph writing.
Source: High School English Grammar and Composition by Wren and Martin.

English.question: ১৬) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) Standing among so many strangers, the frightened child began to sob uncontrollably.
English.option2: খ) Standing among so many strangers, the frightened child began to sob uncontrollable.
English.option3: গ) Standing among with many strangers, the frightened child began to sob uncontrollably.
English.option4: ঘ) Standing among with many strangers, the frightened child began to sob uncontrollable.
English.exp:
Sob is verb, so it should be modified by adverb uncontrollably.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL, page no: 163 & 248

English.question: ১৭) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) There were little time for consultation.
English.option2: খ) We have breakfast at eight.
English.option3: গ) One day a telegram arrives.
English.option4: ঘ) He took of his coat.
English.exp:
Correct sentences:
There was little time for consultation.
One day a telegram arrived.
He took off his coat.
Source: A Practical English Grammar- Oxford University Press.

English.question: ১৮) The last sentence of a paragraph is called a ____.
English.exp: The last sentence of a paragraph is called a terminator.

English.question: ১৯) Choose the wrong sentence.
English.exp:
John stopped studying.
& John stopped to study.
Both sentences are right.
Source: Cliffs TOEFL.

English.question: ২০) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) The end there may be an index.
English.option2: খ) First we used hand tools.
English.option3: গ) We arrived in the morning of the sixth.
English.option4: ঘ) I have seen him somewhere  before.
English.exp:
Correct sentences:
At the end there may be an index.
At first we used hand tools.
We arrived on the morning of the sixth.
Source: A Practical English Grammar- Oxford University Press.

English.question: ২১) Choose the wrong sentence.
English.option1: ক) He has no desire for fame.
English.option2: খ) I intend going to Rajshahi.
English.option3: গ) He is too miserly in part with his money.
English.option4: ঘ) He has invited me for dinner.
English.exp:
Intent on/upon (something): giving all of one's attention and effort to a specific task or goal.
Source: Merriam-Webster DIctionary.

English.question: ২২) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) Do you believe the ghosts?
English.option2: খ) They persisted in defying the law.
English.option3: গ) For a week she lived by bananas & milk.
English.option4: ঘ) It never occured me to insure the house.
English.exp:
Correct sentences:
Do you believe in ghosts?
For a week she lived on bananas & milk.
It never occured to me to insure the house.
Source: A Practical English Grammar- Oxford University Press.

English.question: ২৩) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) He had left without paying his bill.
English.option2: খ) I apologize for not writing before.
English.option3: গ) She insisted to pay for herself.
English.option4: ঘ) Before sign the contract, read the print.
English.exp:
Correct sentences:
He left without paying his bill.
She insisted on paying for herself.
Before signing the contract, read the print.
Source: A Practical English Grammar- Oxford University Press.

English.question: ২৪) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) He was abosrbed to his book
English.option2: খ) She is scared of the dark.
English.option3: গ) He is bad in chess.
English.option4: ঘ) They are very keen to golf.
English.exp:
Correct sentences:
He was abosrbed in his book.
He is bad at chess.
They are very keen on golf.
Source: A Practical English Grammar- Oxford University Press.

English.question: ২৫) Choose the correct sentence.
English.option1: ক) He was happy to be among friends again.
English.option2: খ) Nobody knew the way by Tom.
English.option3: গ) By doing the cooking I help Tom.
English.exp:
Correct sentences:
Nobody knew the way except Tom.
Besides doing the cooking I help Tom.
They live below us.
(We live on the fourth floor & they live on the third.)
Source: A Practical English Grammar- Oxford University Press.

English.question: ৩০) A synonym for resentment is ____.
English.exp:
Resentment (noun) -
- (towards/against somebody) a feeling of anger or unhappiness about something that you think is unfair
- রাগ, বিরক্তি।

Anger (noun) -
- the strong feeling that you have when something has happened that you think is bad and unfair
- রাগ, ক্ষোভ।

Indignation (noun) -
- anger or annoyance provoked by what is perceived as unfair treatment.
- অবিচার, অসদাচরণ ইত্যাদি কারণে রাগ, ক্ষোভ।

Merriam-Webster Dictionary অনুসারে Resentment এর synonym হিসেবে Anger এবং Indignation দুটিই সঠিক।
অপশনে একাধিক সঠিক উত্তর থাকায় উত্তর তুলে দেয়া হয়েছে। 

Source: Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy, Oxford Dictionary and Merriam-Webster Dictionary

English.question: ৪৮) The act of violating the sanctity of the church is -
English.exp:
Blasphemy: the action or offence of speaking sacrilegiously about God or sacred things.
Heresy: belief or opinion contrary to orthodox religious (especially Christian) doctrine.
Sacrilege: violation or misuse of what is regarded as sacred.
Veneration: great respect.

English.question: ৪৯) An expression of mild disapproval -
English.exp:
Warning: advance notice of something.
Denigration: the action of unfairly criticizing someone or something.
Impertinence: lack of respect.
Reproof: an expression of blame or disapproval.
